<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-1401-05-22" status="reviewed"><rs type="school">rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam pa</rs>s ni | rjod byed kyi ngo bo rnaM par rig pa'i tshogs la 'dod do | <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="1b7"/> de dag ni 'og nas rgyas par shes par bya'o || 
            
         'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4242">rog</rs> rjes 'brang dang bcas pa na re brjod bya don ni rtan la dbab rgyu sam shes par bya rgyu yin la | rjod byed tshig ni de rtan la 'bebs par byed pa yin zhes kyang zer ro || </seg></TEI>
